_metadata.title: Geographic Landmarks, NEA Powerhouses, and Agricultural Pockets
_metadata.source: NEA (Nepal Electricity Authority), NARC, Survey Department of Nepal

coffeeLandmarks.name: Aapchaur Historic Coffee Origin Site
coffeeLandmarks.nepaliName: आपचौर — नेपालको पहिलो कफी रोपण स्थल (वि.सं. १९९५)
coffeeLandmarks.significance: Birthplace of Nepali Coffee cultivation introduced by hermit Hira Giri in 1938 BS with seeds brought from Myanmar.

coffeeLandmarks.name: Tamghas District Coffee Center & Cupping Lab
coffeeLandmarks.nepaliName: तम्घास कफी विकास तथा गुणस्तर परीक्षण केन्द्र
coffeeLandmarks.significance: National Coffee Development Board research, seedling propagation nursery, and specialty cupping lab.

coffeeLandmarks.name: Ruru Commercial Coffee Processing Cooperative
coffeeLandmarks.nepaliName: रुरु प्राथमिक कफी प्रशोधन तथा संकलन केन्द्र
coffeeLandmarks.significance: Commercial wet-pulping mill and international specialty grade export grading hub for organic Arabica.

coffeeLandmarks.name: Gulmidarbar Organic Coffee Heritage Pocket
coffeeLandmarks.significance: Dense agro-forestry shade-grown Arabica clusters producing premium high-elevation parchment coffee.

coffeeLandmarks.name: Satyawati Agro-Forestry Coffee & Citrus Ridge
coffeeLandmarks.nepaliName: सत्यवती कफी तथा सुन्तला सघन उत्पादन बेल्ट
coffeeLandmarks.significance: Micro-climate slopes with optimal organic carbon producing floral-noted washed Arabica beans.
